test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_string_hashing_{length} (duplicate_values Array(String)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_string_hashing_{length} WITH i -> concat(char(i), substring(arrayStringConcat(arrayMap( j -> leftPad(hex(cityHash64(number, i, j)), 16, '0'), range(intDiv({length} + 14, 16)))), 1, {length} - 1)) AS key SELECT arrayMap(i -> key(i % 4), range(16)) FROM numbers(intDiv(if({length} >= 16383, 67108864, 8388608), 16 * {length})) SETTINGS max_block_size = 64
